name: Super Black Bass 3D
description: The latest work in the "Super Black Bass" series. Equipped with the "Real Rod System," which is operated by tilting the Nintendo 3DS, you can enjoy powerful battles that feel like you're actually fishing. The game has two modes: ``Tournament Mode,'' where you aim to win the tournament, and ``Free Mode,'' where you can freely set the time, weather, etc. and enjoy fishing freely. In addition, it supports "Internet ranking" where you can compete based on the size of the bass you caught and your tournament results, allowing you to compete with players from all over the world.
